newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chip stocks halt two-session slide; Nasdaq ends lower.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chip stocks halt two-session slide; Nasdaq ends lower.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks closed higher on Monday as a rebound in bonds halted a two-session slide that temporarily drove the Dow Jones industrial average below 8,000 points.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow gained 30.89 points to 8,062.11 after retreating earlier to 7,064 56. But in the broader market, declining issues still led advances by a small margin on volume of 484 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
The Nasdaq composite index was off 10.06 points at 1,588.46.
